Report a Bug opens an issue form for this project on GitHub and copies diagnostic details to the clipboard. Review the text and submit it yourself; nothing is sent before you submit.

Hold an app for about 0.5 seconds to open its menu. Keep holding and move it to enter edit mode. Use the edit button to add apps and widgets, and the confirm button to finish.
Use the Home widget menu to resize or replace widgets. Drag to move, use the size handle to resize, then choose Place or Cancel.

Hold an app over another app for about 0.5 seconds, then release to create a folder. Use + to select apps; they are added in selection order. Drag inside the folder to reorder, or outside the popup to move an app to Home.
Find apps by category or in Recently Installed, or use search. Hold an app for its menu or drag it to Home. Tap empty space to return to the last Home page.

Find apps by name, names in other languages, or Korean pronunciation. With permission, search photos, files, contacts, and calendar events. Turn on content search to search document text and text in photos on this device. Done only hides the keyboard; tap empty space to close Spotlight.

Choose Require Authentication or Hide and Require Authentication from the app menu. Hidden apps are at the bottom of the App Library and appear after unlocking. Protection applies to launching apps and app content inside folio-duo; it does not cover the system notification shade or shared photo, file, contact, or calendar searches.

Choose notification and Quick Settings behavior in Settings. With folio-duo panels enabled, swipe down from the upper-left Home area for notifications or the upper-right area for Quick Settings. Assign upward and downward Home swipes in gesture settings.

Music, calls, and other Live Activities appear above the dock. Tap once to open the app, or hold for about 0.5 seconds to expand. Tap outside or change Home pages to collapse. Brief pop-up settings are in the same menu.

Use Backup in Settings to save and restore layouts, folders, widget settings, security settings, search options, and background photos. You can also move from a debug build to a release build; permissions and authentication may be needed again.
Opening Settings checks this project for a stable GitHub release. If a new version has an APK, you can open its download page. Prereleases are excluded.
